description: Source code for autocast mode in PyTorch, managing automatic mixed precision, caching casts, and registering kernel implementations for different device types and backends.

methods.name: is_autocast_enabled
methods.description: Checks if autocast is enabled for a given device type.

methods.name: set_autocast_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables autocast for a specific device type.

methods.name: increment_nesting
methods.description: Increments the nesting level of the autocast context.

methods.name: decrement_nesting
methods.description: Decrements the nesting level of the autocast context.

methods.name: get_autocast_dtype
methods.description: Retrieves the current autocast data type for a device type.

methods.name: set_autocast_dtype
methods.description: Sets the autocast data type for a device type.

methods.name: is_autocast_cache_enabled
methods.description: Checks if autocast caching is enabled.

methods.name: cached_cast
methods.description: Performs cached casting of tensors to a lower precision type, with heuristics to avoid unnecessary casts.
